source='''def transform(grid):
    width = len(grid[0])
    full_colors = {row[0] for row in grid if all(v == row[0] for v in row)}
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        color = row[0]
        if color in full_colors and 0 < sum(v == color for v in row) < width:
            # The incomplete colored bar is completed in the contrasting color.
            out[r] = [color if v == color else 1 for v in row]
    return out
'''
p.write_text(source)
